cues.text: The command room on the dorm's top floor. You, Yukari and Junpei sit on stools around the low table; Mitsuru, Fuuka and Akihiko sit on the sofa, Akihiko with his arms folded, and Aigis stands beside it. The chairman, Ikutsuki, walks in.
The door opens and Ken walks in to stand beside the chairman. Akihiko, Mitsuru and Fuuka stare at him in surprise.
Akihiko gets up from the sofa and stands facing Ken and the chairman, a hand on his hip.
